title: Cancel
description: From Core (or from an operator interface to Core, which checks it and passes it on): stop whatever motion is running now. The Asset holds (hovers in place, or stays on the ground) and sets run_state paused, so it does not start the next Task until resumed; a new immediate command still runs. It reports the running Task cancelled and answers with report.settings (reply_from and reply_to naming this message). To drop or reorder queued Tasks, send a new control.queue instead.
